statements.status_notes: Backport of nginx's official patch (build/patches/CVE-2024-7347.patch, sha256 69d9e5ee112ce0a31a90d48e78af64734d9bbfcf577eeb896f925ba6d795a6b9) applied to nginx 1.25.5; the package version is unchanged, so version-matching scanners still flag it. Evidence: test/compat_test.py Mp4PatchVerification (the patched check logs 'unordered mp4 stsc chunks'). A crash on the unpatched build was not reproduced.

Debian's security tracker lists the fix in libssl3 3.0.22-1~deb12u2, which is installed. Some scanners compare against upstream OpenSSL numbering (fixed in 3.0.23) and still match. The CVE concerns DTLS; the nginx binary imports no DTLS symbols.

statements.impact_statement: The CVE describes world-readable access.log/error.log files in the default configuration (nginx 1.3.13 and earlier). In this image both are symlinks to /dev/stdout and /dev/stderr; no log files are created. The scanner applies Debian's tracker data for Debian's own nginx package to nginx.org's package.

The CVE (nginx 0.7.64) describes raw terminal escape sequences from requests reaching the log. nginx 1.25.5's default log format escapes non-printable bytes: in a test, an ESC byte in the User-Agent and in the request line was logged as the text \x1B, with no raw ESC byte written.
